2026-09-16.content:
You must [designate a project to manage
Cloud Number Registry](https://docs.cloud.google.com/number-registry/designate-project-cloud-number-registry)
before you can [set up
Cloud Number Registry](https://docs.cloud.google.com/number-registry/set-up-cloud-number-registry)
for an organization.

summary.title: Manage Cloud Number Registry Projects
summary.summary: To set up Cloud Number Registry for your organization, you must first designate a project to manage it. This step is required before proceeding with the setup process.

2026-04-22.content:
**Preview**: [Cloud Number Registry](https://docs.cloud.google.com/number-registry/overview)
provides IP address management (IPAM) capabilities to let you view, manage, and
plan your IP address usage in Google Cloud.

summary.title: IP Address Management in Google Cloud
summary.summary: Cloud Number Registry offers IP address management (IPAM) capabilities within Google Cloud, allowing users to view, manage, and plan their IP address allocation. This feature helps in efficiently organizing and utilizing IP addresses for various cloud resources.
